summary: This is Snowflake's reference page for the DESCRIBE COMPUTE POOL command, which returns properties and metadata for a compute pool used by Snowpark Container Services. It documents the syntax, the name parameter (double quotes needed for special characters and case-sensitive identifiers), and the output columns such as state, node counts, instance family, auto-suspend and auto-resume settings, timestamps, and owner. It also lists the MONITOR privilege required on the compute pool and gives an example describing a compute pool named tutorial_compute_pool with sample output.
one_line: Snowflake reference for the DESCRIBE COMPUTE POOL command, covering its syntax, output columns, MONITOR privilege requirement, and an example.
key_facts: DESCRIBE COMPUTE POOL is available to all Snowflake accounts in AWS commercial regions except for trial accounts.
DESCRIBE can be abbreviated to DESC.
The syntax is DESC[RIBE] COMPUTE POOL <name>.
If a compute pool identifier contains spaces or special characters, the entire string must be enclosed in double quotes, and such identifiers are case-sensitive.
The output column min_nodes shows the minimum number of nodes in the compute pool, and max_nodes shows the maximum.
The instance_family column specifies the machine type of nodes in the compute pool.
The num_services column gives the number of services and jobs running on the compute pool, while num_jobs gives the number of jobs running on it.
The auto_suspend_secs column specifies the number of seconds of inactivity after which the compute pool is automatically suspended.
The active_nodes column gives the number of nodes in the compute pool with one or more services or jobs running.
The owner column shows the role that owns the compute pool.
The MONITOR privilege on a compute pool is the minimum privilege required to execute DESCRIBE COMPUTE POOL.
The example describes the compute pool named tutorial_compute_pool.
In the sample output, tutorial_compute_pool has state ACTIVE, min_nodes and max_nodes of 1, instance_family CPU_X64_XS, and owner ACCOUNTADMIN.
The sample output shows tutorial_compute_pool was created on 2023-05-01 11:42:20.323 -0700 and last updated on 2023-08-27 17:35:52.761 -0700.
